answer: The relic holds work receipts rather than names, so the nebula of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
